label: Telegram + Notion + HubSpot
_note: MCP tool catalogs the agent loads into context when connected to three separate SaaS servers. sample_tools mirror each vendor's documented request schema; tool_count is the documented number of tools each server exposes, used to scale the per-server average. See docs/references.md for sources.

get_updates.name: telegram_get_updates
get_updates.description: Receive incoming updates (messages, edited messages, callback queries) for the bot via long polling. Returns an array of Update objects newer than the given offset.

offset.description: Identifier of the first update to be returned

limit.description: Limits the number of updates to be retrieved (1-100)

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for long polling

allowed_updates.description: List of the update types you want your bot to receive

send_message.name: telegram_send_message
send_message.description: Send a text message to a chat. Supports Markdown/HTML formatting, reply threading, and inline keyboards.

chat_id.description: Unique identifier for the target chat or username of the target channel

text.description: Text of the message to be sent, 1-4096 characters

parse_mode.description: Mode for parsing entities in the message text

reply_to_message_id.description: If the message is a reply, id of the original message

create_page.name: notion_create_page
create_page.description: Creates a new page in a database or as a child of an existing page. Requires parent and properties matching the parent database schema. Each property value must be wrapped in its type-specific object structure (title, select, status, date, people, rich_text).

parent.description: The parent database or page this page belongs to

properties.description: Property values keyed by name or id. title:[{text:{content}}], select:{name}, status:{name}, date:{start,end}, people:[{id}], rich_text:[{text:{content}}]

children.description: Page content as an array of block objects

icon.description: Page icon (emoji or external file object)

cover.description: Page cover, an external file object

query_database.name: notion_query_database
query_database.description: Get a list of pages contained in a database, filtered and ordered. Returns a paginated list of full page objects. Filters use property-type-specific condition objects.

database_id.description: Identifier for the database to query

filter.description: A filter condition or compound (and/or) of conditions on page properties

page_size.description: Number of items per page, max 100

update_object.name: hubspot_crm_update_object
update_object.description: Update the properties of a CRM object (contact, company, deal, ticket). PATCH semantics: only supplied properties change. Returns the full object with default and updated properties.

objectId.description: The record id, or a unique property value when idProperty is set

properties.description: Map of property internal names to new values (all values are strings)

idProperty.description: Optional unique property to use as the id lookup

search_objects.name: hubspot_crm_search_objects
search_objects.description: Search CRM records by property filters, returning matching records with the requested properties. Supports filter groups (OR of ANDs), sorting, and pagination.

objectType.description: The CRM object type to search

filterGroups.description: Groups of filters; groups are ORed, filters within a group are ANDed

limit.description: Max results per page, up to 200
